name: Shikyaku
source:
An old subordinate of Mayfeng.
Since Mayfeng belonged to the Kowloon Kai, he has been active as an assassin of the Kowloon Kai.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=680360]Getchu[/url]]
